common: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: a THREE-FRAME horizontal game walk strip, one row, exactly THREE equally spaced full-body copies of ONE character. Plain exact #FF00FF background, no labels, no ground, no shadows. Preserve the identity, clothing, hair, colours, build and pixel-art treatment of attached identity master. Style standard is Batch 1 Light; named baseline montage contains middle frames of walk_jax_down, walk_karl_down, walk_kyle_down, walk_raelee_down, walk_rod_down. Clean pixel clusters, bold outlines, readable sprite faces, no painterly details. Entire bodies and all feet visible with space around each, same head top and foot baseline in every cell. Uniform frame dimensions. Aim landscape 1536x832, three512x832cells. All figures same scale: approximately740px tall inside cells.

walk.down: All THREE figures face straight toward the viewer, front view. Column1 STRIDE A: screen-left shoe planted low, screen-right shoe raised visibly higher toward knee; opposite arms swing, screen-left hand raised at chest and screen-right hand down. Column2 NEUTRAL STANDING: both shoes together on same baseline, arms hanging. Column3 STRIDE B: screen-right shoe planted low, screen-left shoe raised higher; screen-right hand raised and screen-left hand down. Feet point at viewer throughout, toe fronts visible, NEVER profile-shaped shoes or sideways legs. Shoulder/sleeve/forearm/hand remain continuous.
walk.up: All THREE figures face straight AWAY from viewer, backs of heads and clothing, no faces. Match FRONT strip's figure size EXACTLY: same hair-top, shoulder width, body height and foot baseline. Do not make back figures smaller. Column1 STRIDE A: screen-left heel planted low, screen-right heel lifted noticeably higher; left arm forward away from viewer, right arm back visible beside hip. Column2 NEUTRAL: both heels level, arms down. Column3 STRIDE B: screen-right heel planted low, screen-left heel lifted high; right arm away, left arm back. Shoes show backs of heels, NEVER profile silhouettes. Aprons show only neck loop and waist ties on the back, not a front bib printed on the back. Arms are one continuous shoulder/sleeve/forearm/hand shape.
walk.left: All THREE figures face LEFT in strict side profile: noses, toes and chest point LEFT in every column. COLUMN1 STRIDE A: near leg LIGHT GREY extends forwardLEFT, LEFT shoe planted LOW on baseline. Far leg DARK GREY behindRIGHT, knee bends and RIGHT shoe lifts conspicuously HIGHER. Visible NEAR arm swings backwardRIGHT, forearm/hand projects behind torso at waist height; far arm mostly hidden by torso. COLUMN2 NEUTRAL: feet together below hip, arms straight down. COLUMN3 STRIDE B: SAME near leg remains LIGHT GREY but trailsRIGHT, RIGHT shoe planted LOW on baseline. SAME far leg stays DARK GREY but now extends forwardLEFT, with LEFT knee and LEFT shoe conspicuously HIGHER. Visible NEAR arm swings forwardLEFT, forearm/hand projects in front at waist/chest height; far arm mostly hidden behind body. This is a readable animated walk with alternating planted and lifted foot, NOT two identical contact silhouettes. Near/light and far/dark are PERMANENT limb identities, never choose tone by screen position. Maintain fixed head location and size. All toes still point LEFT. Temporary greys ONLY on trousers; preserve original shoe colours. For skirt wearers keep skirt and bare calves, with lighter near calf and darker far calf. All visible arms are uninterrupted shoulder/sleeve/forearm/hand shapes. Leave generous magenta gutters between figures: extended hands must not touch other cells.

seated.down: ONE single full-body SEATED pose facing straight FRONT. Sitting upright on an INVISIBLE chair, hips bent90degrees, thighs projecting toward viewer foreshortened, knees bent90degrees, shins vertical, shoes together below knees. Hands rest on thighs, shoulders relaxed. All body and shoes visible. Draw PERSON ONLY: absolutely no chair, stool, table, cushion, desk, floor or shadow. Preserve face/hair/outfit/proportions of identity master. Garret alone retains central clipboard in both hands on lap.
seated.up: ONE single SEATED pose facing straight AWAY, back of head and upper body. Hips and knees bent90degrees as seated on INVISIBLE chair, thighs extend away from viewer, compact rounded seated buttocks at lower edge, lower legs mostly hidden by body. Hands on thighs mostly hidden at sides. This is a SITTING body with shortened silhouette, not a standing rear view. No visible face, no chair, furniture, floor, desk or shadow. Preserve hair and outfit from identity. Apron visible only at neckloop/waistties from back.
seated.left: ONE single full-body SEATED pose in strict LEFT side profile. Nose/chest/knees/toes all point LEFT. Torso upright, buttocks sit at imageRIGHT, thighs horizontal extend LEFT, knees bent90degrees, shins hang vertically, feet project LEFT below knees. Hands rest on thighs. Draw PERSON ONLY on INVISIBLE chair, with no chair, table, floor, desk, shadow or cushion. Same identity/hair/clothing as master. For apron let fabric drape over lap with separate trousers below. Garret retains clipboard on lap held centrally.
